summary: First-pass testing of NESU MVP. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases passed (totals schema with all 6 regions, starts at zero on fresh DB verified pre-tests, valid POST /api/pledges returns Certificate & increments the correct region, invalid region/tier/email rejected with 422, totals persist across independent sessions). Frontend: all 6 bottom tabs render at 390px with no horizontal clipping, header language switcher (EN/FR/ع) is present on every screen, Home shows name/tagline/summary/who-for/who-not-for cards, How It Works shows SERVICE != MONEY callout with 6 architecture layers, Corridors renders a fixed 358x201 16:9 video box (testID corridors-video) and 5 corridor cards with 1 'Lead Corridor' + 4 'Roadmap' tags, Comparison references NESU/Bitcoin plus mBridge/Buna/BRICS Pay/e-CNY, Pledge form submit produced a certificate with 'Symbolic Pledge — No Funds Exchanged' watermark, no bitcoin/crypto values, save button transitions Preparing -> enabled, per-region total incremented after submit (Africa 1 -> 2, overall 6 -> 7), Research screen renders 7 document rows (1 EN proposal + Swiss Counsel briefs in EN/FR/AR/DE/ZH/RU) with 'Preview copy' stand-in tags, footer disclaimer text is present on every screen. Two issues flagged: (1) Arabic language selection does NOT set document/body direction=rtl on react-native-web (documentElement.dir stays 'ltr'), which likely means the header/tabs/text alignment are not actually mirrored on web even though isRTL flag flips internal row directions. (2) Corridors screen contains text matching /buy|purchase|price|\$\d+/i — needs manual verification that none of it is a purchase/buy CTA or displayed price (may be legitimate policy language). Minor testID gaps: footer has no testID='footer'; Research rows have no doc-row-* testIDs; 4 of the 5 corridor cards use different keys than the ones the spec suggested (only corridor-europe_algeria matched).

ui_bugs.issue: Selecting Arabic does not flip document direction to rtl on react-native-web (documentElement.dir remains 'ltr'). isRTL only mirrors specific rows; global text alignment, tab order and header layout will not visually mirror in web preview. Consider setting document.documentElement.dir='rtl' on web and/or I18nManager.forceRTL(true) on native.
Footer disclaimer text renders on every screen but the wrapping component has no testID='footer' — makes automated verification and screenshot targeting harder.
Seven document rows render but individual rows do not expose doc-row-<n> testIDs, so opening a specific PDF cannot be reliably targeted in tests.

issues: Text on the Corridors screen matches the regex /buy|purchase|price|\$\d+/i. No visible Buy button was found, but the main agent should manually confirm no dollar amounts, prices, or purchase language remain in copy per the 'NO price or purchase/buy button anywhere' requirement.

action_items: Fix RTL on web: when lang='ar', set document.documentElement.dir='rtl' (and 'ltr' otherwise) so the whole layout visually mirrors, not only rows that read isRTL. On native, call I18nManager.forceRTL/allowRTL.
Audit /src/i18n/content.ts CORRIDORS copy (and any StatusTag labels) for '$', 'buy', 'purchase', 'price' — remove or reword to align with the 'not a financial product' policy.
Add testID='footer' to the persistent footer disclaimer component and testID='doc-row-<index or key>' to each Research row for testability.
(Optional) Align corridor keys with spec-friendly slugs so downstream tests can target them predictably; currently only 'europe_algeria' is present, other 4 keys differ.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_totals iterates all pledges in Python; fine for MVP scale but should switch to a MongoDB aggregation ($match deleted_at:null, $group by region) once volume grows.
PledgeCreate.email uses EmailStr but the response Pledge stores plain str(email); consider normalizing to lowercase before insert to avoid duplicate-key ambiguity later.
Pledge model has deleted_at but there is no DELETE endpoint yet — dead field for MVP, but harmless.
server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan context in a follow-up.
seed_data_creation: Tests created 6 TEST_ pledges (one per region, tier=1000) plus 1 UI-driven pledge (Africa, tier=1000). Totals are no longer zero; the 'starts at zero on fresh DB' requirement was verified BEFORE running tests via a direct GET that returned all zeros. To reset for a clean re-run, drop the 'pledges' collection in the configured MongoDB DB_NAME.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_nesu_pledges.py and reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_nesu_pledges.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. UI note: all tab screens stay mounted on react-native-web, so scope selectors by screen testID (e.g. [data-testid=pledge-screen] [data-testid=submit-pledge]). Tabs are labeled Home / Model / Corridors / Compare / Pledge / Docs. Pledge tier options: 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000. Six region keys: europe, united_states, algeria, middle_east_gulf, brics, africa.
rca_of_issue: RTL bug RCA: useLang() flips an in-memory isRTL flag and individual View styles apply flexDirection:'row-reverse' when isRTL is true, but no code sets document.documentElement.dir='rtl' on web nor calls I18nManager.forceRTL(true) on native. As a result, top-level text alignment, default flex direction of un-marked rows, and the Expo Router bottom-tab order are not mirrored in the web preview even after tapping lang-ar. Reproduction: open the app, tap header 'ع', inspect document.documentElement.dir — it remains 'ltr'. Mitigation: in the i18n provider, on web set document.documentElement.setAttribute('dir', code==='ar'?'rtl':'ltr') inside a useEffect when lang changes; on native gate a one-time I18nManager.forceRTL(code==='ar') behind a reload prompt.
